answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The quill holds work receipts rather than names, so the velvet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lotus of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
